name: Gate USD
oneLiner: Gate USD is Gate's account-linked yield product, subscribed 1:1 with USDT, USDC, or USD1; Gate claims Treasury and stablecoin backing and pays daily GUSD.
collateral: Gate states that GUSD is backed by tokenized Treasury bills and stablecoins, but publishes no current instrument-level allocation or product-specific reserve reconciliation
pegMechanism: Users subscribe 1:1 with USDT, USDC, or USD1 on Gate. Returns accrue from subscription and are distributed daily in GUSD. Gate currently advertises 1:1 redemption into the original subscription asset with no redemption fee; older help materials say fees may vary by redemption mode and market conditions

proofOfReserves.provider: Gate exchange-wide zk-Merkle proof-of-reserves publishes customer and platform balances for GUSD, but this demonstrates Gate's custody of customer GUSD tokens rather than identifying or reconciling the assets backing all issued GUSD; no token-backing attestor is named

notices.title: Circulating-supply caveat
notices.message: Pharos inherits GUSD supply from DefiLlama, whose current series tracks the full Ethereum token supply. Gate subscription figures and CoinGecko circulating supply are lower, so the displayed market cap should not be read as independently reconciled circulating supply.

notices.title: Additional GateLayer representation
notices.message: Gate also operates GUSD on GateLayer at 0xece3f96198a5e6b9b2278edbea8d548f66050d1c. Pharos currently tracks contract telemetry only for the Ethereum deployment.
